senses.gloss:
Vrīhidrauṇika : nt.: Name of the 41st parvan in the list of a hundred sub-parvans of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha 1. 2. 46, 33, 70.

The parvan is called an ākhyāna (vrīhidrauṇikam ākhyānam) 1. 2 46; referred to while listing the contents of the Āraṇyakaparvan 1. 2. 125; related to the adhyāyas 3. 245-247.
